siteIdentity.title: Site identity
siteIdentity.description: What the storefront calls itself. The name reaches the browser title, social previews, logo alt text and structured data; the tagline is the default meta description.

name.label: Site name
name.hint: Leave empty for the built-in name

tagline.label: Tagline
tagline.hint: One line, used as the default page description

storefrontContent.title: Storefront
storefrontContent.description: The figures, the hero badge and the contact details the storefront shows. The site name and tagline are in the identity card above.

heroBadge.label: Hero badge
heroBadge.hint: Short line above the hero heading

portalAppearance.title: Portal appearance
portalAppearance.description: Which template the public storefront renders and which colour mode a visitor starts in. Changes take effect on the next page load.
portalAppearance.notSeeded: The {key} setting has not been seeded yet, so it cannot be changed here. Until it exists the portal uses its {env} environment variable.

nova.label: Nova
nova.hint: Editorial layout with a teal palette — dark/light

portalAppearance.themeDefaultHint: For a visitor who has not chosen one. A visitor's own choice is remembered in a cookie.
portalAppearance.userToggle: Let visitors switch between light and dark
portalAppearance.userToggleHint: Off hides the sun/moon button in the header.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: The storefront's logos and browser tab icon. Changes take effect on the next page load.

logoDark.label: Logo (dark backgrounds)
logoDark.hint: Empty falls back to the light logo

logoMark.label: Mark (square icon)
logoMark.hint: For compact headers and sign-in pages; empty uses the built-in mark

brandColors.title: Brand colours
brandColors.description: Two colours the storefront derives its whole palette from — buttons, links, highlights and the e-mails. Empty keeps each template's own colours.

primary.label: Primary
primary.hint: Buttons, links and highlights. The eleven shades below are derived from it.

brandColors.contrastOk: White text on this colour: {ratio}:1 — passes WCAG AA.
brandColors.contrastDark: White text on this colour: {ratio}:1 — too low, so buttons will use dark text.
brandColors.contrastLow: White text on this colour: {ratio}:1 — below WCAG AA for small text; fine for buttons.

typography.title: Typography
typography.description: The typefaces the storefront uses. All are bundled with it; nothing loads from a font service.
typography.heading: Headings
typography.sampleBody: Domains, hosting and e-mail in one account, with a person on the other end of every ticket.

trackingChat.title: Tracking & chat
trackingChat.description: Third-party services the storefront talks to. Nothing loads until it is configured here.

gtm.label: Google Tag Manager container
gtm.hint: Loads only after a visitor accepts all cookies. Empty loads no tag at all.

chat.title: Live chat
chat.tokenLocaleHint: Optional; empty uses the default token
chat.hint: The widget appears only when a provider, the server and a token are all set.

productFeatures.shownInTheStorefrontS: Shown in the storefront's plan comparison table for
productFeatures.nothingSpecifiedYetTheComparison: Nothing specified yet. The comparison table stays hidden until at least one plan has a line.
productFeatures.plansLineUpByFeature: Plans line up by feature name, so spell it the same way across products — "Disk" and "Disk space" become two separate rows. Within one product a name can only be used once; reusing it is refused rather than saved where it would never show.

productForm.autoGeneratedFromNameEdit: Auto-generated from name. Edit to override.
productForm.hostingPackageNameUsedFor: Hosting package name used for server provisioning. Optional.
productForm.assignToAServerGroup: Assign to a server group for load-balanced provisioning. Optional.
productForm.aBlankCycleLeavesThe: A blank cycle leaves the product unsellable on that cycle in that currency.
productForm.hideThisProductFromThe: Hide this product from the order form
productForm.featuredHint: Show this product with a "Recommended" badge on the storefront. Only one product per group can be recommended; saving this clears the others.
productForm.sortOrderHint: Position inside the group, lowest first. Products with the same number are sorted by name.

products.manageHostingPlansAndServices: Manage hosting plans and services available for purchase
products.noProductsFoundCreateYour: No products found. Create your first product to get started.

slideForm.orTypeMdiIconName: Or type MDI icon name (e.g. cloud-check)
slideForm.optionalTryDemoButtonLink: Optional "Try Demo" button link on the slide
slideForm.optionalSecondaryLinkShownAs: Optional secondary link shown as "Learn More" on the slide
slideForm.youHaveUnsavedChangesAre: You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to leave?

slides.manageHomepageHeroSlidesDrag: Manage homepage hero slides — drag to reorder
slides.noSlidesFoundAddYour: No slides found. Add your first slide to get started.
slides.deleteMessage: Delete "{title}"? This action cannot be undone.

tldConfigForm.currencyUsedByTheRegistrar: Currency used by the registrar for cost prices
tldConfigForm.currencyShownToClientsFor: Currency the sell prices are entered in; clients billed in another currency pay the amount converted with the stored exchange rates
tldConfigForm.makeThisTldAvailableFor: Make this TLD available for purchase
tldConfigForm.youHaveUnsavedChangesAre: You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to leave?

tldConfigs.configureDomainExtensionPricingAnd: Configure domain extension pricing and providers
tldConfigs.noTldConfigurationsFoundAdd: No TLD configurations found. Add your first TLD or import from a provider.
tldConfigs.deleteMessage: Delete ".{tld}" TLD configuration? This action cannot be undone.
